meta.name: notebooklm
meta.description: Complete API for Google NotebookLM - full programmatic access including features not in the web UI. Create notebooks, add sources, generate all artifact types, download in multiple formats. Activates on explicit /notebooklm or intent like "create a podcast about X"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用API生成播客、学习指南等音频内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想通过API批量生成NotebookLM音频内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate podcasts and study guides via API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to programmatically create NotebookLM audio content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 Google NotebookLM 的全部功能，包括创建笔记本、添加来源（网址、YouTube、PDF、音频、视频、图片）、生成播客、测验、闪卡、视频讲解、信息图、思维导图等，并下载多种格式。
howto.when: 当用户明确提到“/notebooklm”或“使用 NotebookLM”，或者表达“创建一个关于 X 的播客”、“总结这些网址/文档”等意图时触发。

say.text: 创建一个关于量子计算的播客。
say.note: Claude 会调用 NotebookLM 生成播客音频。
Claude 会添加网址作为来源并生成摘要。

say.text: 把这篇 PDF 转成闪卡。
say.note: Claude 会添加 PDF 并生成闪卡。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the full Google NotebookLM API to create notebooks, add sources (URLs, YouTube, PDFs, audio, video, images), generate podcasts, quizzes, flashcards, video explainers, infographics, mind maps, and download in multiple formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly mentions "/notebooklm" or "use notebooklm", or expresses intent like "create a podcast about X", "summarize these URLs/documents", etc.

say_en.text: Create a podcast about quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will call NotebookLM to generate a podcast audio.

say_en.text: Summarize the content of these URLs.
say_en.note: Claude will add the URLs as sources and generate a summary.
Claude will add the PDF and generate flashcards.
